;Arts and culture
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
**Fans attend the [[Vive Latino in Mexico City]] despite coronavirus concerns. [https://apnews.com/96c71c1f4bd4c202d1d06e00b9f36d51 (AP News)]

;Business and economy
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**In an emergency move, less than two weeks after the previous unscheduled intervention, the [[Federal Reserve|Fed]] drops its [[federal funds rate|benchmark rate]] a full percentage point. It announces a $700 billion [[quantitative easing]] program, sets [[reserve requirement]]s for thousands of banks to zero and lowers other lending rates. The set of measures appears as its biggest ever in a single day. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/15/federal-reserve-cuts-rates-to-zero-and-launches-massive-700-billion-quantitative-easing-program.html (CNBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A [[pipeline transport|pipeline]] [[explosion]] causes a fire and destroys dozens of buildings in [[Lagos]], [[Nigeria]], killing at least 15 people. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-nigeria-blast-fire/lagos-pipeline-blast-kills-15-destroys-several-buildings-nigerian-officials-idUKKBN2120WN?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Malta]]'s [[Maritime Squadron of the Armed Forces of Malta|Navy]] rescues 112 migrants from a sinking boat in the [[Mediterranean Sea]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/15/world/europe/15reuters-malta-migrants.html (''New York Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
***[[Uzbekistan]] confirms the [[Central Asia]]n country's first case of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], an Uzbek citizen who had recently returned from [[France]]. All schools, colleges and universities are ordered to close for three weeks, while all public events are cancelled. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-uzbekistan/uzbekistan-confirms-first-coronavirus-case-closes-schools-borders-idUKKBN21206Q?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in Italy jumps to 24,747, while the death toll rose to 1,809 people. [https://www.corriere.it/salute/malattie_infettive/20_marzo_15/coronavirus-italia-24747-casi-1809-morti-bollettino-15-marzo-bc5b0f58-66d8-11ea-a26c-9a66211caeee_amp.html (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***Noted Italian architect [[Vittorio Gregotti]] dies in [[Milan]], at age 92, after contracting coronavirus. [https://www.corriere.it/cultura/20_marzo_15/morto-vittorio-gregotti-maestro-dell-architettura-novecento-ba9468ca-6699-11ea-a26c-9a66211caeee.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***The [[Republic of the Congo]] reports its first case of coronavirus, a 50-year-old man who arrived in the country on an [[Ethiopian Airlines]] flight from [[Paris]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-congorepublic/congo-republic-reports-first-coronavirus-case-government-statement-idUKKBN2120AM?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 1,209 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 113 more deaths, the highest number of deaths in a single 24-hour period in the country to date, bringing the total to 13,938 confirmed cases and 724 deaths. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/irans-death-toll-from-coronavirus-reaches-724-health-official-on-twitter-idUSKBN2120G0?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kazakhstan]]
***[[Kazakhstan]] declares a [[state of emergency]] over the coronavirus pandemic. The presidential decree from [[President of Kazakhstan|President]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] imposes a national quarantine and restricts both entry and departures from the country to all except diplomats and individuals invited by the [[government of Kazakhstan|government]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/in-sparsely-hit-central-asia-kazakh-coronavirus-infections-rise-to-six-first-uzbek-case/30488671.html (RFE/RL)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[President of Argentina|President]] [[Alberto Fernández]] reinforces security at the borders and bans all travelers from hard-hit countries that spent at least 14 days there. In addition, he says he is considering a national quarantine and suspension of school classes. [https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/controls-tightened-at-border-as-officials-seek-to-put-brakes-on-incomings.phtml (''Buenos Aires Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Palestine]]
***The [[Jerusalem Islamic Waqf]] announces the closure of the [[Al-Aqsa Mosque]] and [[Dome of the Rock]] to upend contamination of the holy sites from COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/jerusalem-al-aqsa-mosque-shut-precaution-coronavirus-200315103612710.html (Al Jazeera)]
***The corruption trial of Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], originally slated to open on March 17, has been delayed to May 24 due to restrictions on public gatherings enacted to stop coronavirus spread. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/15/netanyahu-corruption-trial-delayed-by-coronavirus-restrictions-he-enacted/ (''New York Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports its first death from COVID-19, a 75-year-old man. [https://index.hu/english/2020/03/15/coronavirus_hungary_first_fatality_case_number_32/ (Index)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 232 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 14 more deaths. The UK government says a "wartime-style" mobilisation will be enforced in the coming weeks to tackle the virus. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-03-15/uk-coronavirus-death-toll-rises-to-35-as-14-more-patients-die-after-testing-positive-for-covid-19/ (ITV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 2,000 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 105 more deaths, as the country enters a nationwide lockdown. [https://www.brecorder.com/2020/03/15/580257/spain-coronavirus-cases-jump-by-a-third-over-100-new-deaths/ (''Business Recorder'')]
****[[Pere Aragonès]], [[Vice President of Catalonia]], confirms via Twitter he tested positive for the virus. [https://m.europapress.es/catalunya/noticia-vicepresidente-pere-aragones-da-positivo-prueba-coronavirus-20200315174213.html (Europa Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Cabinet of the Netherlands|Government]] closes down all [[Education in the Netherlands|schools]] and [[Horeca]] establishments, and the [[Royal Dutch Football Association]] suspends all football matches until April 6. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2020/03/the-netherlands-on-lockdown-schools-cafes-and-sports-clubs-shut/ (DutchNews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]], [[2020 Tyrol coronavirus lockdown]]
****[[Günther Platter]], the governor of the Austrian state of [[Tyrol (state)|Tyrol]], announces a statewide lockdown set to last for one week, out of concerns of the coronavirus. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/2020/03/15/business/austria-shuts-restaurants-bans-some-flights/ (''The Boston Globe'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****Germany closes its borders with [[France]], [[Switzerland]], [[Austria]], [[Denmark]] and [[Luxembourg]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51897069 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
****[[Slovenia]] closes all schools indefintely and suspends [[public transport]] effective midnight as COVID-19 cases rise to 219. [https://www.total-slovenia-news.com/politics/5866-coronavirus-slovenia-daily-summary-15-03-non-essential-stores-closed-flights-down (Total Slovenia News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Liechtenstein]]
****The government announces a tightening of the measures: all the events with more than five people are banned, including religious services, entertainment and leisure businesses are suspended, in particular museums, libraries, sport facilities, casinos and the mountain railways. Restaurants, bars, discos and nightclubs are also closed, although take-away service will be allowed. [https://www.regierung.li/media/attachments/120-corona-massnahmen-verschaerft-0316.pdf?t=637203447788083667 (Government of Liechtenstein)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***Canada's public health agency posts an advert for nurses, citing "an urgent need". Prime Minister [[Justin Trudeau]] says he does not rule out the possibility of closing the borders. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-canada/canada-will-not-rule-out-border-closures-urgently-seeks-to-hire-nurses-idUSKBN2120VF (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The American [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] issues a recommendation to suspend gatherings of 50 or more people for the next two months. [https://www.npr.org/2020/03/15/816245252/cdc-recommends-suspending-gatherings-of-50-or-more-people-for-the-next-8-weeks (NPR)]
***The governors of five states: [[California]], Ohio, [[Illinois]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]] and [[Massachusetts]], order bars and restaurants to close in response to the pandemic. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2020/03/15/coronavirus-bars-restaurants-closed-states/5055634002/ (''USA Today'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****The [[Ohio]] [[Ohio Department of Health|Department of Health]] reports it now has 37 cases of COVID-19 in the state. [https://www.cleveland.com/healthfit/2020/03/36-people-in-ohio-have-confirmed-coronavirus-ohio-department-of-healths-sunday-update.html (''Cleveland Plain Dealer'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] orders the [[New York City Department of Education|city's public schools]] close until April 20. [https://www.nydailynews.com/coronavirus/ny-coronavirus-education-20200315-3kfqdealqvbmjjtg6ofd45q5ty-story.html (''New York Daily News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] Governor [[Gretchen Whitmer]] reports the state now has 20 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 than yesterday, for a total of 53. [https://www.wxyz.com/news/national/coronavirus/12-new-cases-of-coronavirus-reported-in-michigan-bringing-total-to-45 (WXYZ-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas]]
****[[Arkansas]] Governor [[Asa Hutchinson]] announces the closing of all public schools in the state beginning March 17 over coronavirus concerns. [https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2020/mar/15/illness-total-reaches-16-state-health-department-r/ (''The Arkansas Democrat-Gazette'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
***Turkey's Presidential Communications Director Fahrettin Altun reports 12 new confirmed cases, totalling 18. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/number-of-coronavirus-cases-in-turkey-increases-to-18/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala]]
***[[Guatemala]] reports the country's first death from the coronavirus, an 85-year-old man who had recently returned from [[Spain]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-central-america/guatemala-reports-first-coronavirus-death-an-elderly-man-back-from-spain-idUKKBN2121D6?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential debates]]
**The first one-on-one debate of the 2020 Democratic presidential primaries takes place between former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]] and [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Bernie Sanders]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], instead of [[Arizona]] as originally scheduled and without an audience as a result of the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-election/amid-coronavirus-crisis-biden-and-sanders-go-head-to-head-in-democratic-debate-idUKKBN2120DK (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Georgia Democratic primary]]
**[[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] postpones its primary elections to May 19 after 66 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] were reported in the state. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Health/wireStory/georgia-2nd-state-postpone-pres-primaries-virus-69602029 (ABC News)]
*The [[Royal Household of Spain]] announces that the King has refused the heritage of his father after emeritus King [[Juan Carlos I]] had been involved in a tax haven scandal and money-laundering. His public fund is also withdrawn. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20200315/474164914213/rey-felipe-iv-renuncia-herencia-juan-carlos-i-retira-asignacion-casa-real.html (''La Vanguardia'')]

;Science and technology
*A [[SpaceX]] [[Falcon 9]] rocket aborts takeoff shortly after igniting its engines. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/spacex-falcon-9-rocket-safely-aborts-takeoff-after-engine-ignition-and-shutdown/ (CBS News)]

;Sports
*[[2020 NFL season]]
**[[National Football League]] players vote to ratify a proposed [[NFL Collective Bargaining Agreement|CBA]] rule that changes the NFL regular season to seventeen games and the playoff format to seven games. [https://amp.usatoday.com/amp/5045997002 (''USA Today'')]
